The '''Houk District''' was the region of [[Meirm City]] that was inhabited by [[Houk/Legends|Houks]]. It contained the [[Gricul Salvage Yards]], a salvage yard secretly operated by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="LoNH" />
